heading: Discover great motorcycle roads
introduction: RoadRatings helps motorcyclists discover and compare riding roads through detailed ratings and firsthand experience. Explore the map, browse the road data, or learn how the project is taking shape.

sections.heading: Roads worth exploring
paragraphs: California is the starting point for a growing collection of paved, twisty roads. The aim is to help riders find roads that suit the experience they want, from scenic outings to more demanding rides.

sections.heading: More than a single score
paragraphs: RoadRatings describes roads across multiple rating categories so you can compare their characteristics. Read the story behind the project and the approach to collecting road information.

sections.heading: Explore the underlying road data
paragraphs: Browse the spreadsheet to inspect and compare the collected road information. Recorded ratings describe the road and the riding experience; they are not live reports of traffic, closures, or conditions.
